description: ``.claude/settings.json``'s PreToolUse matcher was narrowed to ``"Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|Bash|PowerShell|ExitPlanMode|mcp__.*"``. Claude Code filters hook invocations by the matcher BEFORE spawning the subprocess, so when a Task subagent dispatch or TodoWrite / SlashCommand / BashOutput tool call fired, the matcher excluded those tool names — write_guard.main() was never invoked and its kill-switch + protected-zone gates silently skipped the dispatch. Fix: ``harness_config.CANONICAL_HOOK_WIRING`` declares ``matcher="*"`` for both write_guard and plan_guard; ``espalier/cli.py`` reads matcher strings from CHW (no hard-coded constants); ``.claude/settings.json`` regenerates with the widened matcher. Each hook's internal MUTATION_TOOLS filter (write_guard.py:677, plan_guard.py:313) is the read-only fast-path so the spawn cost stays bounded.
documented_in: tests/test_hooks.py::TestPreToolUseMatcherCoverage (2 tests: non-mutation pass-through and kill-switch fires for Task/TodoWrite/SlashCommand/BashOutput dispatches)
